newsitem.title: USA: Motor Club of America sells unit, sees gain.
newsitem.headline: Motor Club of America sells unit, sees gain.

text.p: Motor Club of America said on Monday that it sold Motor Club of America Enterprises Inc for $1.125 million to JVL Holding Properties Inc.
Motor Club will post a fourth quarter gain of $735,000, or $0.36 a share from the sale, it said.
Motor Club will provide certain servicing facilities in JVL for the operation of Motor Club of America Enterprises, the company said.
The sale of Motor Club Enterprises will enable the company to focus on expanding and diversifying its insurance operations, it said.
